question.description: A message to `user` that is a question (the `ask_user` tool).

recipient.description: `user`, an agent's id, or a job's task holder.

seen.description: The decision-log version the sender last read: behind the log, nothing is sent and the answer is held.

sender.description: Only the Lisp backend names a sender (its agents' messages); an editor always sends as the user.

Decision.description: One decision as the log has it (`drgnx-coord--decision-plist`).

result.description:
`messages/send`'s answer (`drgnx-coord-send`): `{ok, id, state}` (state `queued`, or `held` when the recipient's
queue is full or the two talk too much), or `{held, version, changes}` when the sender's `seen` is behind the log
(nothing was sent; `changes` are the decisions after `seen`, newest first).
result.title: SendResult

methods.doc: the hub's state: versions, refusals, read-only, the backend, the gateway
methods.name: status

params.description: Params of a method that takes none: any keys are dropped (and listed in `ignored`).
params.title: Empty

Backend.description: The Lisp backend behind the front (phases 1–6).

GatewayStatus.description:
The gateway the front serves: its loopback port (none until it listens), the registrations held, and what it
carried since the hub started (requests answered, those that failed, fallbacks, request and answer bytes); the
provider table's size, the ids whose key the hub holds (never a key) and the clear-text warnings.

errors.description: Requests whose provider answered 4xx or 5xx, or none at all.

McpStatus.description: The coordination tools the front serves: the sessions' sockets, and the outside bridges connected now.

ProviderWarning.description: A warning about one provider (a keyed one whose key travels in clear text).

Refusals.description: The refusals the hub counted, and the last ones (method, code, class, path; never params).

Runtime.description: The binary that serves: its version and build commit.

StoreStatus.description: work.db as the front's writer has it.

backup_ok.description: Whether that copy passed its check.

denied_in.description:
The copies that still hold what the migration's deny-list kept out of work.db (the pre-migration copy,
`work.db.schema5`): the doctor offers removing them.

failed.description: Why the move from schema 6 failed (it is not tried again until the hub restarts; `work.db` is still schema 6).

last_backup.description: The newest backup copy (Task 17's daily ones).

migrated_at.description: When the move from schema 6 committed (unix seconds; none for a file made at schema 7).

schema.description: `meta.schema` at the last look (0: no file).

writes.description: The transactions the front's methods committed since the hub started.

WriterState.description:
Whether the front's writer can write work.db: a schema-7 file the hub made or migrated (`not-ready` while the
migration waits or after it failed, `read-only` for a newer file).

result.description: The hub's status: the Lisp hub's keys and the front's.

gateway.description: The gateway the front serves (none from a Lisp hub).

gateway_port.description: A Lisp hub's gateway port (Ratatoskr says `gateway.port`).

mcp.description: The front's MCP hosting (none from a Lisp hub).

read_only.description: work.db's schema, when it is newer than the hub's and so the hub is read-only.

store.description: The front's writer (none from a Lisp hub).

result.title: HubStatus
